description: A fixture-tier subset of ChEMBL release 37 (13 compounds, selected as: 13 named compounds (scripts/chembl_extract_subset.py FIXTURE_IDS) and the parent of any salt form among them), 493 names and synonyms, 1697 targets and 6172 activity summaries aggregated per compound, target, standard type and unit (median, minimum, maximum and counts over exact values; censored values counted only). A selection and an aggregation of ChEMBL, not ChEMBL: check assay-level records before relying on a value.
